claims.text: An in vitro serum study of aminoglycosides including amikacin reports little inactivation by cefazolin.
claims.quote: Based on the results, the beta-lactams can be divided into three groups: (1) cefazolin and cefamandole, which cause little inactivation;

headline.text: An in vitro serum study reports little aminoglycoside inactivation by cefazolin.

reported.text: The study tested aminoglycosides including amikacin in serum mixtures and placed cefazolin among agents causing little inactivation.

gaps.text: The packet does not provide a controlled human interaction study of amikacin and cefazolin.
